name: Don Percival

intro.text: I demand the right to finish my pint! And to read in peace. And to... ah, fight, I suppose. I'm a don. I'm in the habit of disagreeing.

win: A palpable hit. I yield. Mind the leaf, it's older than the pub, the college and my sense of shame.
